capabilities.summary: Shared scenario interpreter and durable state machine for the RightKit scenario runtime: perform separated from observe_until, idempotency keys, append-only fsync step journal with resume into observe, leases with fencing tokens, cooperative cancellation with a deadline, retake replay with postcondition comparison, and the remote worker transport trait boundary
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the interpreter, journal, lease and retake machinery are not an ownership fingerprint.
No networking, GUI driving or capture lives in this crate; workers implement StepDriver and remote transport implements WorkerTransport in later slices.
